quests.instruction: Ben's cooking show films at 11:40 AM for 1 hour and 25 minutes. What time does filming end?
quests.hint: Starting at 11:40 AM, count 1 hour and 25 minutes forward one part at a time.
quests.explanation: Adding 1 hour and 25 minutes to 11:40 AM carries the clock all the way around to 1:05 PM.
quests.funFact: An hour and a half of filming can capture a whole recipe from start to finish.

quests.instruction: Which time is the same as quarter past four in the afternoon?
quests.hint: For "quarter past four": quarter to means minutes before the hour, quarter past means minutes after it.
quests.explanation: 4:15 PM is the digital match for that spoken time.
quests.funFact: Quarter past four means fifteen minutes have passed since four o'clock.

quests.instruction: Breakfast is finished by 8:00 AM after 1 hour and 15 minutes of cooking and eating. What time did cooking start?
quests.hint: Starting at 8:00 AM, count 1 hour and 15 minutes backward one part at a time.
quests.explanation: Subtracting 1 hour and 15 minutes from 8:00 AM lands exactly on 6:45 AM.
quests.funFact: A big family breakfast can take over an hour from stove to table.

quests.instruction: Which time is earliest: 11:20 PM, 12:00 AM, or 11:45 PM?
quests.hint: Look closely at 11:20 PM, 12:00 AM, 11:45 PM — remember that midnight flips PM into AM.
quests.explanation: 11:20 PM is the earliest, coming before both 12:00 AM and 11:45 PM.
quests.funFact: 11:20 PM is the earliest here, since midnight and 11:45 PM both come after it.

quests.instruction: It is 12:55 PM. What time will it be in 3 hours and 45 minutes?
quests.hint: Break 3 hours and 45 minutes into two steps: add the hours, then the minutes, from 12:55 PM.
quests.explanation: 3 hours and 45 minutes after 12:55 PM is 4:40 PM.
quests.funFact: Adding almost four hours to just after noon lands well into the afternoon.

quests.instruction: Ella's museum tour begins at 8:50 AM and lasts 2 hours and 20 minutes. What time does it end?
quests.hint: Starting at 8:50 AM, count 2 hours and 20 minutes forward one part at a time.
quests.explanation: Adding 2 hours and 20 minutes to 8:50 AM lands exactly on 11:10 AM for Ella.
quests.funFact: A long museum tour can cover many different exhibits.

quests.instruction: Which time is the same as quarter to eight in the morning?
quests.hint: Break "quarter to eight" into the hour word and the quarter word separately.
quests.explanation: Written as a digital time, that phrase becomes 7:45 AM.
quests.funFact: Quarter to eight means fifteen minutes remain before eight o'clock arrives.

quests.instruction: The class art mural is finished at 3:25 PM after 3 hours and 5 minutes of painting. What time did painting begin?
quests.hint: Break 3 hours and 5 minutes into two steps: subtract the hours, then the minutes, from 3:25 PM.
quests.explanation: 3 hours and 5 minutes before 3:25 PM is 12:20 PM.
quests.funFact: A big classroom mural can take several hours of careful painting.

quests.instruction: Which time is latest: 12:30 AM, 12:15 AM, or 11:50 PM?
quests.hint: Line up 12:30 AM, 12:15 AM, 11:50 PM in the order a clock would tick through them.
quests.explanation: Since 12:30 AM happens last on the clock, it is later than 12:15 AM and 11:50 PM.
quests.funFact: Both AM times here happen after midnight, and 12:30 AM is the later of the two.

quests.instruction: It is 10:05 PM. What time will it be in 2 hours and 50 minutes?
quests.hint: Watch closely — adding 2 hours and 50 minutes to 10:05 PM rolls over into a new half of the day.
quests.explanation: Adding 2 hours and 50 minutes to 10:05 PM carries the clock all the way around to 12:55 AM.
quests.funFact: Adding just under three hours to a late night time often crosses midnight.

quests.instruction: Omar's late movie starts at 11:30 PM and runs 1 hour and 45 minutes. What time does it end?
quests.hint: Add the hours in 1 hour and 45 minutes first, then add the minutes, starting from 11:30 PM.
quests.explanation: 1 hour and 45 minutes after 11:30 PM is 1:15 AM, after rolling over into a new half of the day for Omar.
quests.funFact: A late movie night can stretch on past midnight.

quests.instruction: Which time is the same as quarter to two in the afternoon?
quests.hint: Turn "quarter to two" into a digital time one small piece at a time.
quests.explanation: That wording matches 1:45 PM on a digital clock.
quests.funFact: Quarter to two means fifteen minutes remain before two o'clock arrives.

quests.instruction: The family road trip ends at 10:00 PM after 5 hours and 30 minutes of driving. What time did they leave?
quests.hint: Subtract the hours in 5 hours and 30 minutes first, then subtract the minutes, from 10:00 PM.
quests.explanation: Going back 5 hours and 30 minutes from 10:00 PM gives 4:30 PM.
quests.funFact: A long road trip can cover a lot of ground in five and a half hours.

quests.instruction: Which time is earliest: 11:15 AM, 12:00 PM, or 1:00 PM?
quests.hint: Among 11:15 AM, 12:00 PM, 1:00 PM, watch for which times are just before or just after midnight.
quests.explanation: 11:15 AM is the earliest, coming before both 12:00 PM and 1:00 PM.
quests.funFact: 11:15 AM is still morning, making it earlier than both afternoon times.

quests.instruction: It is 8:30 AM. What time will it be in 4 hours and 45 minutes?
quests.hint: Add the hours in 4 hours and 45 minutes first, then add the minutes, starting from 8:30 AM.
quests.explanation: Adding 4 hours and 45 minutes to 8:30 AM rolls past the halfway point of the day, landing on 1:15 PM.
quests.funFact: Nearly five hours after a morning start usually lands in the early afternoon.

quests.instruction: Lily's baking marathon starts at 10:20 AM and takes 3 hours and 50 minutes. What time is she finished?
quests.hint: Break 3 hours and 50 minutes into two steps: add the hours, then the minutes, from 10:20 AM.
quests.explanation: Adding 3 hours and 50 minutes to 10:20 AM carries the clock all the way around to 2:10 PM.
quests.funFact: A baking marathon can fill the whole kitchen with wonderful smells.

quests.instruction: Which time is the same as quarter past ten at night?
quests.hint: For "quarter past ten": quarter to means minutes before the hour, quarter past means minutes after it.
quests.explanation: 10:15 PM is the digital match for that spoken time.
quests.funFact: Quarter past ten means fifteen minutes have passed since ten o'clock.

quests.instruction: Morning chores are finished by 7:40 AM after 2 hours and 10 minutes of work. What time did chores begin?
quests.hint: Starting at 7:40 AM, count 2 hours and 10 minutes backward one part at a time.
quests.explanation: Subtracting 2 hours and 10 minutes from 7:40 AM lands exactly on 5:30 AM.
quests.funFact: Farm chores often take a couple of hours before the rest of the day begins.

quests.instruction: Which time is latest: 12:45 PM, 12:20 PM, or 11:50 AM?
quests.hint: Look closely at 12:45 PM, 12:20 PM, 11:50 AM — remember that midnight flips PM into AM.
quests.explanation: Since 12:45 PM happens last on the clock, it is later than 12:20 PM and 11:50 AM.
quests.funFact: 12:45 PM is the latest, since it comes after both 12:20 PM and 11:50 AM.

quests.instruction: It is 1:20 PM. What time will it be in 5 hours and 15 minutes?
quests.hint: Break 5 hours and 15 minutes into two steps: add the hours, then the minutes, from 1:20 PM.
quests.explanation: 5 hours and 15 minutes after 1:20 PM is 6:35 PM.
quests.funFact: A little over five hours after lunchtime often lands in the evening.

quests.instruction: Noah's overnight bus ride begins at 11:15 PM and lasts 2 hours and 30 minutes. What time does it arrive?
quests.hint: Starting at 11:15 PM, count 2 hours and 30 minutes forward one part at a time.
quests.explanation: Adding 2 hours and 30 minutes to 11:15 PM rolls past the halfway point of the day, landing on 1:45 AM for Noah.
quests.funFact: Overnight bus rides often arrive while most passengers are still asleep.

quests.instruction: Which time is the same as quarter to four in the early morning?
quests.hint: Break "quarter to four" into the hour word and the quarter word separately.
quests.explanation: Written as a digital time, that phrase becomes 3:45 AM.
quests.funFact: Quarter to four means fifteen minutes remain before four o'clock arrives.

quests.instruction: The overnight bake-off judging ends at 1:00 AM after 4 hours and 45 minutes of baking and tasting. What time did it begin?
quests.hint: Break 4 hours and 45 minutes into two steps: subtract the hours, then the minutes, from 1:00 AM.
quests.explanation: 4 hours and 45 minutes before 1:00 AM is 8:15 PM.
quests.funFact: A long bake-off can stretch from evening well into the night.

quests.instruction: Which time is earliest: 11:59 AM, 12:01 PM, or 12:30 PM?
quests.hint: Line up 11:59 AM, 12:01 PM, 12:30 PM in the order a clock would tick through them.
quests.explanation: 11:59 AM is the earliest, coming before both 12:01 PM and 12:30 PM.
quests.funFact: 11:59 AM is just one minute before noon, making it the earliest of the three.

quests.instruction: It is 11:10 PM. What time will it be in 1 hour and 55 minutes?
quests.hint: Starting at 11:10 PM, count 1 hour and 55 minutes forward one part at a time.
quests.explanation: Adding 1 hour and 55 minutes to 11:10 PM carries the clock all the way around to 1:05 AM.
quests.funFact: Almost two hours after a late night time usually crosses into a new day.

quests.instruction: Ivy's hiking trip starts at 9:35 AM and lasts 4 hours and 10 minutes. What time does she return?
quests.hint: Watch closely — adding 4 hours and 10 minutes to 9:35 AM rolls over into a new half of the day.
quests.explanation: 4 hours and 10 minutes after 9:35 AM is 1:45 PM, after rolling over into a new half of the day for Ivy.
quests.funFact: A long hike can take most of the day when the trail is beautiful.

quests.instruction: Which time is the same as quarter to one in the afternoon?
quests.hint: Turn "quarter to one" into a digital time one small piece at a time.
quests.explanation: That wording matches 12:45 PM on a digital clock.
quests.funFact: Quarter to one means fifteen minutes remain before one o'clock arrives.

quests.instruction: The class ends its garden project at 11:15 AM after 1 hour and 35 minutes of planting. What time did they start?
quests.hint: Subtract the hours in 1 hour and 35 minutes first, then subtract the minutes, from 11:15 AM.
quests.explanation: Going back 1 hour and 35 minutes from 11:15 AM gives 9:40 AM.
quests.funFact: Planting a whole garden bed can take well over an hour of digging and watering.

quests.instruction: Which time is latest: 12:15 AM, 11:45 PM, or 11:30 PM?
quests.hint: Among 12:15 AM, 11:45 PM, 11:30 PM, watch for which times are just before or just after midnight.
quests.explanation: Since 12:15 AM happens last on the clock, it is later than 11:45 PM and 11:30 PM.
quests.funFact: 12:15 AM happens after midnight, making it later than both PM times before it.

quests.instruction: It is 9:40 AM. What time will it be in 3 hours and 35 minutes?
quests.hint: Watch closely — adding 3 hours and 35 minutes to 9:40 AM rolls over into a new half of the day.
quests.explanation: Adding 3 hours and 35 minutes to 9:40 AM rolls past the halfway point of the day, landing on 1:15 PM.
quests.funFact: A little over three and a half hours after a morning start lands in the afternoon.
